summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary and empty-class cases. Nothing was run; verification was by reading only. Lines over 120 columns: none added (one pre-existing line in dice.py is 128 columns). Nothing committed. Choice to review: cross-sample TP and D are computed by summing distance maps over the sample axis first (batch x voxels cost rather than batch² x voxels), which is mathematically equivalent.
